packages.purpose: Lets agents read and edit the Notion pages and databases that you share with an integration of your own.
permissions: Reads and edits the pages and databases you have shared with the integration.
What it may do is also limited by the capabilities you give the integration in Notion (for example, read-only).
Nothing outside what you share with the integration.

credential.label: Notion integration token
credential.hint: In Notion, open Settings, Connections, Develop or manage integrations, create an internal integration and copy its token (it starts with ntn_).
